data.one_liner: A lightweight Flutter widget that detects URLs, emails and hashtags in text and makes them clickable.
data.what_it_does: It parses a string for linkable patterns such as URLs, email addresses, hashtags and user mentions. The widget renders the text with customizable styles and provides a tap callback for each link.
use_when: You need simple link detection without heavy dependencies
You want customizable link styles in a Text widget
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without platform channels
avoid_when: You require advanced rich‑text editing or link creation UI
You need support for markdown or HTML rendering
You need deep integration with native link handling beyond tap callbacks
strengths: Small footprint and only depends on flutter
Easy to use API with style customization
Supports hashtags and @mentions out of the box
weaknesses: Limited to link detection; no editing capabilities
No built‑in support for opening links (you must handle onTap)
No markdown or rich‑text parsing beyond basic patterns
